# AccrualOS

> AccrualOS is the practice management and automation platform for Australian accounting and bookkeeping firms. It is built by Sharktech Global. Dainu Devis is CEO of Sharktech Global.

AccrualOS connects CRM, enquiries, appointments, client communication, onboarding, workflow follow-up, AI assistants and managed growth services in one configured system. It does not replace Xero, MYOB or QuickBooks. The accounting platform remains responsible for the ledger, reporting and accounting functions.

Sharktech Global is the technology and delivery company behind AccrualOS product development, integrations and support. Dainu Devis, CEO, Sharktech Global, is chief executive of Sharktech Global.

The site copyright names Divine Empyrean Pty Ltd, ABN 54 672 825 731, Sydney NSW.

Contact: sales@sharktech.com.au, +61 468 017 373. Hours listed on the site: Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm AEST.
